brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck the city of Nabatiyeh in southern Lebanon on Sunday evening, killing three Lebanese nationals and wounding additional people, Shehab Wire reported. The strike targeted a vehicle in the residential area.

The deaths mark the latest toll from military operations in the border region. Southern Lebanon has faced repeated Israeli bombardment in recent months amid escalating cross-border hostilities between Israeli forces and armed groups operating in Lebanese territory. Nabatiyeh, located roughly 40 kilometers from the Israeli border, has been among the areas most affected by the strikes.
